You deserve a starting place that reaches your actual week. In Return to Yourself, your live 90-minute workshop includes:

- **Claim Your Priorities:** A priorities exercise to name what keeps getting pushed aside.
- **Let Your Voice Count:** Boundary-script practice for requests that usually cost you your own time.
- **Make the Time:** Guided calendar planning that gives one personal priority a real place.
- **Continue the Change:** A seven-day practice plan for continuing after the session ends.
- **Ask Your Questions:** Live Q&A to help you connect the exercises to your situation.
- **Keep It Close:** An emailed workbook so your notes and next steps have somewhere to live.

B.copy_markdown:
Your business should not need your attention for every small decision. In the live two-hour Own Your Week owner lab, you receive:

- **Find the Bottleneck:** A bottleneck audit to locate work that repeatedly comes back to you.
- **Clarify Who Decides:** A decision-rule worksheet for clarifying which choices your team can make.
- **Share the Responsibility:** A handoff template to define the result, owner, and next step.
- **Give Leadership Time:** A guided weekly operating-plan exercise to protect leadership time.
- **Ask Your Questions:** Live Q&A to connect the tools to your working reality.
- **Keep It Close:** An emailed workbook that keeps the exercises together for use afterward.

Your story needs somewhere to begin, not another demand to be brilliant. The Unwritten Chapter is a one-day live virtual retreat with:

- **Find Your Beginning:** A scene-selection exercise to choose one manageable memory.
- **Bring It to Life:** Guided drafting time to put that scene into words.
- **Strengthen Your Voice:** Revision prompts to help you hear what is already yours.
- **Carry the Story Forward:** A next-page plan for returning to the draft after the retreat.
- **Ask Your Questions:** Live Q&A about the writing process and the exercises.
- **Keep It Close:** An emailed workbook to hold your notes and developing pages.

Sharing is optional; you choose what remains private.

Ready to give your own plans a place? Here is how to begin.

1. Open the registration form for Return to Yourself, enter your details, and look for your confirmation.
2. Follow your confirmation link into the optional community, where you can introduce yourself when ready.
3. Check your email for the workshop workbook bonus, and save it somewhere you can find during our session.
4. If you choose SMS updates, look for Maya's welcome text using the number you provided when registering.
5. Add the live session to your calendar and save the access link from your email before the day arrives.
6. Share the registration link with a friend who also needs some room to hear their own priorities again.
7. Bring the priority you are ready to choose. Your own life belongs in these plans. Come give it a place you intend to keep.

Before you join me, I want you to know why I care so much about the person you keep putting last: you.


I remember closing my notebook after agreeing to another favor. My own plans were still there, untouched. I smiled when they thanked me. Then I sat alone, ashamed of how easily I had disappeared again.


I chose an hour and kept it. My own name finally belonged beside a commitment I honored.


That is why Return to Yourself exists: to help you give your voice, your choices, and your time a place.


Join me in the live workshop. Bring the dream you have almost stopped mentioning.


You belong in the life you keep giving so much to. Come put your own name back in it.

With care, Maya Vale

B.copy_markdown:
Before you join me, I want you to know why this is personal: I know what it feels like to come home without arriving.


I answered messages while my family talked around me. I nodded. I laughed. Later, I could not remember their conversation. Being needed at work had become my excuse for being absent everywhere else.


I began handing over decisions, not just tasks. I wanted to hear the whole story at dinner again.


Own Your Week exists because the freedom we build should have room for the people we love.


Join me in the live lab. Bring the work you are ready to stop carrying alone.


You built this business. Now give yourself a way to be there for the life you built it for.

With respect, Marcus Reed

C.copy_markdown:
Before you bring your story here, I want you to know why your own voice matters to me. I once kept deleting mine.


I erased a detail because it sounded too ordinary. Then another. The paragraph became polished, and the memory disappeared. I wanted to sound like an author. I had stopped sounding like myself.


I put the detail back. For the first time that afternoon, I recognized the life I was trying to write.


That is why I created The Unwritten Chapter: your voice deserves room to grow, not instructions to disappear.


Join my virtual retreat. Bring the story you keep carrying. Let us put it on the page.


Your life has already given you something to say. Come give those words a place to begin.

With warmth, Elena Brooks
